title.zh: Mistral Large 4：预览版与开放权重计划
title.en: Mistral Large 4: Preview and Open-Weight Plans

excerpt.zh: Mistral Large 4 已开放 API 预览，权重计划于 10 月底发布。其多模态、编程和网络安全表现引人关注，独立验证与实际部署仍值得观察。
excerpt.en: Mistral Large 4 is available as an API preview, with weights planned for release by October’s end. Its multimodal, coding, and cybersecurity results stand out, but independent validation and deployment remain important

text.zh: Mistral Large 4（ML4）已推出公开 API 预览，Mistral 表示计划在 10 月底发布模型权重。公司称，该模型拥有 1 万亿参数，其中 490 亿为活跃参数；预览服务运行在其欧洲数据中心。
text.en: Mistral has opened a public API preview of Mistral Large 4 (ML4) and says it plans to release the model weights by the end of October. The company describes the model as having one trillion parameters, with 49 billion active, and says the preview runs in its European data centers.

text.zh: Mistral Large 4 的能力与评测
Mistral 将 ML4 定位为面向编程、智能体工作流和多模态理解的开放权重模型，并公布了网络安全、软件工程、视觉定位及专业知识工作等多项基准结果。例如，公司称模型在 Cybench 挑战集上完成了 93% 的题目，并在一项真实软件漏洞复现与修补测试中得分 82%。这些数字来自 Mistral 援引的评测，不能单独代表所有实际使用场景。
text.en: Mistral positions ML4 as an open-weight model for coding, agent workflows, and multimodal understanding. It reports benchmark results across cybersecurity, software engineering, visual grounding, and professional work. For example, the company says the model solved 93% of Cybench challenges and scored 82% on a test involving reproducing and patching a real software vulnerability. These are reported evaluation results, not a guarantee of performance in every deployment.

text.zh: 开放权重带来的选择与待验证问题
text.en: Open weights: more control, questions remain

text.zh: 权重开放后，组织可望在私有云或本地环境部署模型，并按自身政策管理用途；对于需要审计或持续开展安全研究的团队，这种控制权可能很重要。Mistral 还表示，模型使用覆盖 160 多种语言的多语言训练数据，并计划提供多个地区的部署选项。
text.en: Once the weights are released, organizations are expected to be able to deploy the model in private-cloud or on-premise environments and apply their own policies. That control may matter to teams conducting security research or needing auditable systems. Mistral also says training data included more than 160 languages and that deployments will be available in multiple regions.

text.zh: 目前权重尚未发布，Mistral 称正在与网络安全领域的合作方开展红队测试，并计划后续披露架构、更多基准和训练后方法。关键问题仍是外部评测能否复现其结果，以及模型开放后的安全措施、部署成本和长期可用性如何。
text.en: The weights are not yet available. Mistral says it is conducting red-team testing with cybersecurity partners and plans to share more about the architecture, benchmarks, and post-training methods. Open questions include whether independent evaluations will reproduce the reported results, and how safety controls, deployment costs, and long-term availability will work in practice.
